abstract_contract.arbitration: round-robin fair choice when both offers are present
abstract_contract.cancel_reset: preaccept cancellation produces no commands; pending cancellation suppresses unaccepted remainder and drains accepted work; held reply persists through reset until ACK
abstract_contract.identity: failed/invalid identity is rejected before controller command issue
abstract_contract.ownership: one accepted transaction at a time; no grant switch before bridge-specific physical drain and caller response ACK
abstract_contract.reads: one BL8 read produces exactly eight x16 beats; then require two consecutive ctrl_idle samples before response
abstract_contract.reply: owner, bridge-native identity, error and completion fields remain stable while held
abstract_contract.writes: one logical 8-byte row is four x16 writes; drain accepted words, traverse WAIT_BUSY fence edge, observe ctrl_idle in WAIT_IDLE, then hold response until ACK

excluded_clients_or_work: finite logical reference and scratch service
limitations: No RTL equivalence, simulation, or formal proof is performed by this model.
No real SDRAM command/response, pin timing, refresh, turnaround, row-miss, or backpressure service is modeled.
No finite closed shared budget, 30-fps result, or under-10-ms result is claimed.
The abstract fair arbiter and response protocol need validation against the integrated RTL interface.
Writer and reader identity tuples intentionally differ; root live-frame lease supplies their cross-client correlation.
A future ticket requirement beyond the writer's opaque token needs separate interface qualification.

failed_identity_no_commands.reason: writer epoch zero is invalid; opaque token zero is allowed

scope: Finite logical ownership contract model; not RTL proof, not real pin service, and not a latency or closed shared-service budget.

interface_identity_roles.adapter_rule: preserve each bridge's native identity; root live-frame lease correlates them; do not invent writer generation/ticket fields
interface_identity_roles.rgb_reader: nonzero epoch + nonzero generation + bank + byte address
interface_identity_roles.writer: nonzero epoch + opaque 32-bit token (zero allowed and echoed) + bank + byte address
